pr_title: Adjust beatmap carousel padding to avoid scrollbar disappearing underneath logo

issue_context.title: Beatmap scrollbar appears below the osu! logo
issue_context.body:
### Type

Cosmetic

### Bug description

The scrollbar in song select appears below the osu! logo making it not accessible by the mouse.

### Screenshots or videos

![image](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/55355558/55944901-5aa7-4626-8204-912e03887e82)


### Version

2024.221.0-lazer

### Logs

[compressed-logs.zip](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/14386586/compressed-logs.zip)

Yeah I noticed this changes things slightly, but I think it's okay? Can adjust if you think there's a reason to.

It annoys me because not only does it look wrong and imbalanced but it also breaks right-click-to-absolute-scroll slightly. Like try right-clicking in the padded area at the bottom:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/20418176/5562d6dd-d4d0-4ee4-8c42-5ada7b7bb5ab

I wanted to try and offer constructive solutions to the issue but I'm afraid that after trying a bit I've got none right now.

I've noticed the right scroll was clamping correctly from the top but not the bottom. This seems to fix it:

```diff
diff --git a/osu.Game/Graphics/Containers/OsuScrollContainer.cs b/osu.Game/Graphics/Containers/OsuScrollContainer.cs
index 124becc35a..ffd28957ef 100644
--- a/osu.Game/Graphics/Containers/OsuScrollContainer.cs
+++ b/osu.Game/Graphics/Containers/OsuScrollContainer.cs
@@ -127,7 +127,7 @@ protected override bool OnScroll(ScrollEvent e)
         }
 
         protected virtual void ScrollFromMouseEvent(MouseEvent e) =>
-            ScrollTo(Clamp(ToLocalSpace(e.ScreenSpaceMousePosition)[ScrollDim] / DrawSize[ScrollDim]) * Content.DrawSize[ScrollDim], true, DistanceDecayOnRightMouseScrollbar);
+            ScrollTo(Clamp(ToLocalSpace(e.ScreenSpaceMousePosition)[ScrollDim] / DrawSize[ScrollDim] * Content.DrawSize[ScrollDim]), true, DistanceDecayOnRightMouseScrollbar);
 
         protected override ScrollbarContainer CreateScrollbar(Direction direction) => new OsuScrollbar(direction);
 
```

https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/35318437/d3877270-cd39-4306-a84d-b9412e5f96ff

May want to change the position to be based on the middle of the scrollbar (not top).

Seems to fix so I've applied.
